scope.landslide: Frozen-model agreement on 1,393,305 shared valid pixels in road-selected tiles; possible overlap with model training/validation. Not an independent test or road-blockage accuracy.
scope.width: Carriageway width against NZTA on the validation subset. Available valid samples differ: n=36 slope-only and n=41 calibrated. This does not validate the lenient drivable-width rule.
scope.rounding: Metrics retain the values used to plot the archived figures. The width metadata are rounded to three decimals; the notebook display used two decimals.
